name: synthient
description: Detect residential proxies, VPNs, Tor, and proxy botnets from your codebase. Bundles the Synthient MCP server and adds the judgment it lacks: how to read a lookup, how to integrate one, and how to migrate off Spur or IPQualityScore.

api_key.title: Synthient API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the CLI's own credentials: the SYNTHIENT_API_KEY environment variable, a .env file, or the OS keychain via `synthient auth`. Get a key from the dashboard at https://synthient.com.
